# AgentSea

> AgentSea launches supported AI coding agents locally or on cloud infrastructure, pre-wired to The Grid inference API.

## Start here

- Homepage: https://agentsea.thegrid.ai/
- CLI reference: https://agentsea.thegrid.ai/cli
- How AgentSea works: https://agentsea.thegrid.ai/how-it-works
- Why AgentSea: https://agentsea.thegrid.ai/why-agentsea
- Sitemap: https://agentsea.thegrid.ai/sitemap.xml
- Public agent and cloud manifest: https://agentsea.thegrid.ai/manifest.json
- Source repository: https://github.com/the-gridai/agentsea

## Priority launch guides

- OpenClaw locally: https://agentsea.thegrid.ai/openclaw/local
- OpenClaw on DigitalOcean: https://agentsea.thegrid.ai/openclaw/digitalocean
- Hermes Agent locally: https://agentsea.thegrid.ai/hermes/local
- Hermes Agent on DigitalOcean: https://agentsea.thegrid.ai/hermes/digitalocean

Use the sitemap to enumerate every supported agent and cloud launch guide. Every launch guide has a self-referencing canonical URL and contains the exact AgentSea command for that combination.

## The Grid

- The Grid homepage: https://thegrid.ai/
- The Grid agent map: https://thegrid.ai/llms.txt
- Integration documentation: https://thegrid.ai/docs/integrations-and-best-practices/integrations
- OpenClaw integration: https://thegrid.ai/docs/integrations-and-best-practices/integrations/openclaw.md
- Hermes Agent integration: https://thegrid.ai/docs/integrations-and-best-practices/integrations/hermes-agent.md
